question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s entrenched authority as CCP general secretary, Central Military Commission chairman, and state president underpins the 95.5% trader consensus against removal before 2027. Recent military leadership changes, including the early 2026 investigation of senior figures, have further centralized power without evidence of factional pushback or elite realignment. Leadership transitions in China have historically aligned with scheduled party congresses rather than sudden ousters, and the 21st Party Congress is not until late 2027. Public continuity in policy and appearances through mid-2026 reinforces this positioning. Low-probability shifts could still arise from an acute health event, an economic shock prompting internal consensus against continued rule, or an external crisis eroding cohesion before year-end.
